image_description: A close-up shot of an adult bison and a calf standing in a grassy field. The adult bison is on the left, facing forward-left, displaying a large shoulder hump, shaggy dark brown fur, and a beard. A smaller calf stands closely beside the adult's right flank, partially obscured but visible. Another bison's rear is visible in the background.

The eye visible on the left side of the face is dark and clearly defined.
